scope: Exactly eleven stable platform IDs: printed maximum game depth band normalized to approved game upper bound and undamaged surface-speed ceiling. Exactly six conventional battery IDs have verified Btry Rtng/technology/AIP facts. Each numeric consumer checks the separate per-field applicability registry. Historical database max_depth_m and v1-v3 semantics stay separate. No runtime navigation fit, water depth, initial charge, lithium chemistry, snorkel hardware or initial AIP reserve is created.

depth_band_conversion.source: Harpoon V2026-01-01 PDF28 printed3-6 Submarine Depth Bands
depth_band_conversion.interpretation: Parent-approved game interpretation: use the upper end of the printed maximum permitted game band as the continuous engine depth ceiling. The annex prints a band, not an independently measured engineering hull-depth limit.
depth_band_conversion.rounding: No interpolation, measurement estimate, extrapolation or battery-rating substitution; select the printed band upper end.
depth_band_conversion.binding: Exact platform ID lookup only; no prefix, display-name, country, construction-year or Kilo-family inference.
